calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.hint: Who is booked, when. Click an empty time to book it; drag an appointment to move it.
calendar.noResourcesHint: Add the people, rooms or chairs that clients book, under Staff and rooms.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.hint: Every booking, newest first. Open one to move it, cancel it or take it through to the invoice.
appointments.search: Search by client, phone or number
appointments.emptyHint: Book the first one from the calendar, or share your online booking page so clients can book themselves.

frontDesk.title: Front desk
frontDesk.hint: Today, {{date}}: who is coming, who is here, who is done.
frontDesk.hintShort: Who is coming, who is here, who is done.
frontDesk.emptyHint: When someone walks in, add them as a walk-in and they are checked in straight away.
frontDesk.toInvoice: {{count}} finished appointment(s) still need an invoice.

form.title: New appointment
form.noServices: No bookable services yet. Add one under Services offered.
form.freeTimesHint: Times when someone is free for the whole service, with its set-up time.
form.noTimes: No free time on this day.
form.outsideHours: Book a time of my own choice (outside working hours)
form.customerHint: Pick an existing customer, or type the details below.
form.name: Client's name
form.seriesSkipped: Booked, but {{count}} time(s) did not fit and were skipped: {{problem}}

drawer.title: Appointment {{number}}
drawer.requestedHint: A client asked for this time online. Confirm it to tell them it is booked.
drawer.noInvoicing: Invoicing is not available: switch on Point of sale and Customers to bill appointments.

cancel.title: Cancel the appointment of {{name}}
cancel.hint: The time is freed straight away and the client is told. A cancellation inside the cancellation window is marked late.
cancel.doneLate: Cancelled, and marked as a late cancellation.
cancel.waitlistMatches: {{count}} person(s) on the waitlist could take this time.

noShow.title: Mark as did not come?
noShow.message: The time is freed. This cannot be undone.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.hint: Clients waiting for a time. When something frees up, offer it to them.
waitlist.offerHint: They get a message with the time. When they say yes, press "They said yes" to book it.
waitlist.removeMessage: {{name}} will no longer be offered times.
waitlist.emptyHint: When a day is full, add the client here and offer them a time when someone cancels.

resources.title: Staff and rooms
resources.hint: The people, rooms, chairs or machines clients book, with their working hours and time off.
resources.emptyHint: Add the first person, room or chair, with the hours they work.
resources.name: Name
resources.nameHint: What clients and staff call it, for example Amina or Chair 2.
resources.hoursHint: Write the hours like 09:00-17:00. For a break, write two periods: 09:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00. Leave empty for a day off.
resources.badHours: Check the hours: write them like 09:00-17:00.
resources.showPublicly: Clients can choose this one on the online booking page
resources.timeOffAffected: {{count}} appointment(s) already fall in this time. They are not moved: move or cancel them yourself.
resources.levelHint: Prices can differ by level, such as Senior or Junior.

offers.title: Services offered
offers.hint: What clients can book: how long it takes, what it costs and who does it.
offers.emptyHint: Add a service, such as a haircut or a consultation, then choose who can do it.
offers.itemHint: Linking it lets you invoice the appointment. Add service items under Products.
offers.noItems: There are no service items yet. Add one under Products (type: service) to invoice appointments.
offers.name: Name
offers.bufferHint: Set-up and clean-up time is kept free around each appointment but clients do not see it.
offers.priceHint: What the invoice will charge, tax included.
offers.noResources: Add people or rooms first, under Staff and rooms.
offers.descriptionHint: Shown on the online booking page.
offers.procHint: While colour sets the person is free to serve someone else.
offers.recallHint: Clients are reminded when this many days pass. Empty: never.
offers.depositHint: Asked when the booking is made. 0 means none.
offers.variantsHint: A price for a staff level (every senior stylist) or a kind of client (long hair). Staff can pick one when booking.
offers.lateHoursHint: For this class. Empty uses the business's cancellation window.
offers.exampleHint: This price came with your pack. Change it to make it yours.

settings.title: Booking settings
settings.hint: How online booking, notice, reminders and invoicing work.
settings.onlineHint: A page where clients choose a service and a time themselves.
settings.addressHint: Letters, digits and dashes. Clients open this address to book.
settings.needAddress: Choose a booking address before you switch online booking on.
settings.publicNameHint: Leave empty to use the business name.
settings.publicNoteHint: A line or two at the top of the page.
settings.consentHint: Leave empty for the standard wording.
settings.autoConfirm: Confirm online bookings straight away (otherwise you confirm each one)
settings.showPeople: Let clients choose who they book with
settings.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
settings.qrAlt: QR code of the booking page. Scan it to open the page.
settings.embedHint: Paste this into your website where the button should appear.
settings.rulesHint: Apply to clients booking online. Staff can book at short notice.
settings.minNoticeHint: 120 means clients cannot book less than 2 hours ahead.
settings.granularityHint: How often a new time is offered.
settings.defaultBufferHint: Used when you add a service without its own.
settings.cancelWindowHint: Cancelling closer to the start than this is marked as late.
settings.remindersHint: Clients get a message before their appointment, by the best way you can reach them.
settings.quietHint: Reminders wait until this time is over.
settings.billingHint: Bill a finished appointment to its customer.
settings.noInvoicing: Invoicing is not available: switch on Point of sale and Customers to bill appointments.
settings.invoiceAuto: Create the invoice when an appointment is finished
settings.dueDaysHint: Leave empty to use the customer's usual terms.
settings.policyHint: The business's own rules for missed visits, deposits and discounts at the till.
settings.lateFee: Late cancellation fee (% of the price)
settings.lateFeeHint: Charged on the client's next bill when they cancel inside the window. 0 means no fee.
settings.noShowFee: Missed appointment fee (% of the price)
settings.noShowFeeHint: Charged when a client does not come. 0 means no fee.
settings.feeItemHint: Fees appear on the bill under this item.
settings.needFeeItem: Choose the service item fees are billed under, or set both fees to 0.
settings.depositNoteHint: Sent to clients who owe one, for example the till number to send it to.
settings.waitConfirm: Time to confirm a freed place (minutes)
settings.waitConfirmHint: A class place offered to someone waiting is held this long. 0 puts them on straight away.
settings.patchDays: A patch test is good for (days)
settings.patchDaysHint: Services that need a patch test warn when the last one is older. Leave empty for no limit.
settings.discountLimit: Discount a cashier may give (% of the bill)
settings.discountLimitHint: Above this a manager must approve. Leave empty for no limit.
settings.comeBackHint: Reminders to clients who are due again and a thank-you with an invitation to rebook.
settings.recallsOn: Message clients who are due again
settings.rebookHoursHint: After a finished visit with nothing booked. 0 means never.
settings.sampleHint: A week of made-up clients and visits to see the screens working. It bills nothing and can be removed.
settings.sampleHave: {{count}} sample visits are in the calendar.
settings.sampleGone: Sample visits removed. The sample clients stay in Customers.

widget.nobodyDue: Nobody is due again right now.
widget.noClasses: No classes in the next 7 days.
widget.classHint: {{taken}} of {{places}} places in the next {{count}} classes

public.title: Book an appointment
public.noServices: Nothing can be booked online right now.
public.noTimes: No times on this day. Please try another day.
public.name: Your name
public.contactHint: Give a phone number or an email so we can reach you.
public.slow: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
public.offline: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
public.closedTitle: Online booking is not available here
public.closedHint: Check the address, or contact the business directly.
public.errorHint: Something went wrong. Please try again.
public.doneConfirmedHint: We will remind you before your appointment.
public.doneRequestedHint: The business will confirm it soon. You will get a message.
public.deposit: A deposit of {{amount}} is needed to hold your time.

clientCard.title: Client card
clientCard.owesFees: Owes {{count}} fee(s) from earlier visits. They appear on the next bill.

extras.billedToPayer: Billed to an insurer or scheme. Pre-authorisation: {{ref}}. Patient pays: {{copay}}.
extras.hasClaim: A claim is open for this visit. The insurer's part is billed from Claims.
extras.depositRecorded: Deposit recorded. It is kept for the bill.
extras.depositHint: The money is kept on the client's account and used when they check out.
extras.noPayers: No insurers set up yet. Add them in Claims first.
extras.claimHint: The insurer's part is billed from Claims. The patient's co-pay becomes the claim's excess.
